question: How do differentiated knowledges arise even within what is called Śiva?
premises: Even in the state called Śiva, knowledges of difference appear.
These varied knowledges are extended or unfolded.
They arise when the left and right of the three faces come into union.
inference: Differentiated knowledges emerge within Śiva through the conjunction of the left and right aspects of the three faces.
plain_english: Even in what is called Śiva, varied knowledges of difference were unfolded when the left and right aspects of the three faces came together.
